messages:
Maya Chen: FYI team — finalizing the analyst/press packets for the Benchmark launch. Embargo: 2026-06-10T15:00Z. I uploaded a consolidated "Quick Facts" sheet with a Fact-check tab. Please claim quotes + drop approvals here. Link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=benchmark-quickfacts-2026

Aaron Patel: I'll take the performance quote (latency + throughput). Will post a 1-line quote shortly. :+1:

Lena Ortiz: Taking pricing/cost narrative and the analyst one-pager. Do we need Legal sign-off on every quote or just final packet?

Jordan (Legal): Legal wants sign-off on final quote text before distribution. Quick guidance: avoid absolute superlatives like "lowest" unless backed by specific run IDs. Use phrasing like "best observed in our tests" and include run IDs in the fact-check tab.

Samir Gupta: Adding run IDs and infra notes to Fact-check: run-20260602-1a, run-20260603-2b (A100-80GB, 4k context, fp16+quant). I'll attach perf logs and verification steps tonight.

Maya Chen: Proposed embargoed excerpt to seed with analysts: 

```quote
"Redwood Inference reduces inference cost by up to 3x on common LLM workloads while maintaining production latency SLOs."
```

Maya Chen: Call out objections now if any.

Aaron Patel: Nit: use the multiplication symbol "3×" in final copy. Also append hardware note in-parens: (A100-80GB, fp16+quant).

Lena Ortiz: Works for comms. PR prefers attribution line like — Aaron Patel, Head of Product for the analyst packet.

Jordan (Legal): Attribution is fine. I'll do a quick legal pass on the final quote tomorrow AM. Make sure run IDs and logs are in Fact-check.

PR Bot: Reminder scheduled — internal analyst dry run: 2026-06-08 09:00 PT; embargo lift: 2026-06-10 15:00Z.

Maya Chen: Timeline: everyone drop final quote + explicit "approved" by 12:00 PT tomorrow. I'll compile into the press packet and add an approval column. PR will only distribute once Legal confirms.

Aaron Patel: Draft: "Redwood Inference reduces per-token inference cost by up to 3× on common LLM workloads (A100-80GB, fp16+quant) while meeting production latency SLOs." — Aaron Patel, Head of Product.

Lena Ortiz: Approved from comms. No edits.

Jordan (Legal): Approved pending perf log attachments and run IDs in Fact-check.

Samir Gupta: Uploaded logs and checklist: model config, dataset snapshot, perf logs, validation steps. Noted two outlier runs; flagged in the Fact-check tab.

Maya Chen: Thanks. Locking quote as approved for analyst/embargoed materials once Legal confirms the Fact-check attachments. If any analyst asks for more detail, direct them to ops@redwood with the run IDs. :rocket:
